mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate below 3.5% signals an overheating labor market that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE is below 3.5%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales signals robust consumer demand, driving corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS are rising, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a decline in industrial production signals weakening manufacturing activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods in late-cycle expansions where INDPRO declines, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation, prompting central bank rate hikes that depress equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% YoY, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In housing boom regimes (HOUST above 1250 thousand units), rising home construction activity fuels consumer spending and corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where HOUST exceeds 1250, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in non-farm payrolls and declining unemployment signals a robust labor market, driving consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS is rising and UNRATE is falling, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (index base 2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns as recession risks increase.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO is below 100, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
